args.Aisle: Every morning I make a brew before work, and on Saturdays I take my tea to the
cricket club. Right then, here's my list for today: 2 ceiling lights with a CN
plug type, and 3 milk teas that weigh at least 360 g each. Fingers crossed it's
a straight bat all round! All in, I can spend 4700 pence, so that's the total
for the lot. Every item on that list should be ready to ship, so nothing that's
out of stock, please. I'd hate to be bowled a no-ball! Home cupboard or pavilion
shelf, either could end up holding it. After 2 messages from you, I stop
replying. Each tool call counts as a step, and 35 steps are yours.
14/15 them. | OrderWrapUp: Closes out the session; WayChoice=commit buys what
